tickets.title: Monorepo skeleton with green empty verify pipeline
tickets.objective: Bootstrap the repo so every downstream verify command can run: workspace layout per DESIGN Architecture, docker-compose (postgres, neo4j, redis), lint/type/test configs for py+ts, root `make verify` green on empty suites.
acceptance: 1. `make verify` exits 0 on fresh clone with services up
2. compose brings up postgres+neo4j+redis healthchecked
3. package layout matches DESIGN (packages/protocol, packages/store-agent, apps/{buyer,merchant,exchange,trust}, services/{ingest,shopify-stub,sim}, pixel/)

tickets.title: Contracts generate typed models and enforce the dual-path bid boundary
tickets.objective: packages/contracts: JSON Schemas per DESIGN §Interfaces (partner-reconciled Intent with hard_constraints/preferences, Bid with optional message + seller_asserted provenance, VerificationResult), codegen to Pydantic + TS, and boundary validation: hosted bids reject on any non-hook provenance; external bids admit seller_asserted claims flagged for verification; expired/blacklisted/invalid reject on every path. OpenAPI examples + consumer contract tests for every cross-domain endpoint.
acceptance: 1. Schema→codegen produces importable py+ts types for all pinned objects incl. VerificationResult
2. Hosted-path bid with a seller_asserted claim rejects; external-path bid with the same claim admits flagged-for-verification; expired/blacklisted reject on both
3. Round-trip serialization passes in both languages; every cross-domain endpoint has a checked-in OpenAPI example + contract test
tickets.verify: pytest packages/contracts -q && npx vitest run packages/contracts
non_goals: No service code; schema changes after this land only via E1 tickets

tickets.title: Postgres schemas enforce role isolation and hash-chained ledger
tickets.objective: Create ledger/sealed/vault/app schemas with roles per DESIGN §Data models using the partner-reconciled table set (commerce_events with idempotency + prev_hash chain, claims, claim_verifications, verification_evidence_refs, trust_observations, trust_scores, policy_events, ranking_runs/candidates, catalog_snapshots, crawl tables, seller_blacklist with review states); replay library; grant tests prove exchange role cannot read sealed.* (S7).
acceptance: 1. Migrations apply cleanly; all FKs + blacklist/idempotency indexes present
2. Grant test: exchange role SELECT on sealed.* fails
3. commerce_events enforces idempotency_key uniqueness and valid prev_hash; replay reproduces stream hash

tickets.title: Neo4j attribute-node catalog with vector retrieval through EmbeddingProvider
tickets.objective: Partner-reconciled graph model (Product/Variant/Offer/Category/AttributeValue/Ingredient/Source with SUPPORTED_BY provenance; uniqueness constraints on all stable IDs; no free-text-only product matching), 1024-dim cosine vector index on Product.embedding, EmbeddingProvider + HashEmbedding double, upsert + candidate-query library.
acceptance: 1. Constraints + indexes created idempotently; every material fact upserts with a SUPPORTED_BY Source
2. Vector+attribute candidate query returns seeded products under HashEmbedding
3. Re-embed script passes on sample data; provider swap is config-only

tickets.title: Shopify stub reproduces the exact surface the system uses
tickets.objective: Local service implementing: discountCodeBasicCreate (usageLimit, expiry, combinesWith), orders query subset, webhook delivery (orders/paid, orders/fulfilled, refunds/create), cart-permalink redemption honoring code validity, and pixel event emission incl. documented non-firing mode (C9, A4).
acceptance: 1. Contract tests assert request/response parity with recorded real-API shapes for each mutation/query used
2. Permalink redemption applies valid codes and silently ignores invalid/conflicting ones (matching real behavior)
3. Configurable pixel drop-rate; webhooks always delivered

tickets.title: LLM client with per-role config, cache-first prompts, and test doubles
tickets.objective: Wrapper for Anthropic API: model IDs from env per DESIGN, static-context-first prompt assembly for caching, recorded/deterministic doubles for tests.
acceptance: 1. Role→model resolution from env with documented defaults
2. Prompt assembly puts store context before dynamic tail (cache boundary test)
3. Double replays recorded fixtures deterministically; no network in tests

tickets.title: Signed fetch adapter ingests a storefront including password-protected dev stores
tickets.objective: CatalogAdapter interface + signed_fetch impl: products.json + JSON-LD, storefront-password session, identified UA + robots.txt, content-hash change detection. SSRF-guarded fetching: private/link-local blocked, redirects bounded to allowed hosts, crawl budgets (pages, depth, time, bytes).
acceptance: 1. Adapter ingests stub storefront fixture incl. password mode
2. robots disallow honored (test)
3. Unchanged content produces zero re-extraction work (hash test)
4. SSRF tests: private-IP and unsafe-redirect fixtures are refused; budgets enforced

tickets.title: Policy pages and marketing claims land in the graph with provenance
tickets.objective: Fetch shipping/return/guarantee pages; Haiku-class extraction on hash change; decompose to atomic Claims; upsert with Source(source_class=scraped) and snapshot refs.
acceptance: 1. Given fixture pages, extracted Claims match approved expectation file
2. Every claim/attribute has a SUPPORTED_BY Source with snapshot ref; low-confidence extraction is quarantined, not upserted
3. Re-run on unchanged pages performs no LLM calls (double counts)

tickets.title: Same products across stores link via entity resolution
tickets.objective: GTIN exact match plus embedding+attribute matcher producing SAME_AS edges with confidence; threshold config.
acceptance: 1. On the approved ER fixture set, precision ≥ configured floor and GTIN matches always link
2. Edges carry confidence; below-threshold pairs are not linked

tickets.title: Catalog MCP adapter passes recorded-contract tests
tickets.objective: catalog_mcp CatalogAdapter implementing the production-primary read path against recorded mocks (dev stores are not in Global Catalog — A1).
acceptance: 1. Adapter satisfies the CatalogAdapter interface tests
2. Contract tests replay recorded MCP responses; mapping to graph upserts matches signed_fetch semantics
non_goals: No live Shopify calls in verify

tickets.title: Differential refresh keeps the graph current at field-appropriate cadence
tickets.objective: Scheduler with per-field cadence config; only changed content re-extracts; refresh endpoint.
acceptance: 1. Cadence config drives which adapters run (frozen-clock test)
2. POST /refresh/{store} triggers one store's pipeline
3. No re-extraction without hash change across a full cycle
non_goals: No pixel-feed intake (arrives via merchant app events)

tickets.title: Auctions fan out, time out, and always represent every store
tickets.objective: Auction state machine in Redis; POST /auctions; parallel BidRequest fan-out with hard timeout; list-price fallback bids for Tier-0 and non-responding stores (R10).
acceptance: 1. Auction with 3 responsive + 1 silent + 2 Tier-0 stores yields 6 ranked entries, silent one at list price
2. Timeout enforced (frozen clock); late bids rejected
3. State machine transitions logged to ledger via trust API stub

tickets.title: Candidate retrieval and fit scoring feed the ranker
tickets.objective: Vector+attribute retrieval from Neo4j, rerank behind an interface (deterministic double in tests), fit score per candidate logged per bid.
acceptance: 1. Retrieval returns hard-criteria-satisfying candidates only
2. Fit scores deterministic under double; logged with auction
3. Latency budget test under fixture load

tickets.title: Shortlists rank by the single published formula behind eligibility filters
tickets.objective: Eligibility filters (blacklist fail-closed, offer expiry, checkout-domain validity, hard constraints requiring verified facts per R19), then published rank_score per DESIGN §Decisions with [0,1]-normalized features, policy penalties, stable tie-breaking, component map + human-readable explanation; slotting ≤4 with graceful collapse; provenance + verification-warning labels.
acceptance: 1. Golden tests: fixed inputs → exact eligibility set, ranking, slots, explanations
2. Blindness test: tier/fee fields cannot alter score; contradicted hard constraint never wins regardless of other components (release blocker test)
3. Filter tests: blacklisted/expired/bad-domain/hard-fail excluded with exclusion_reasons recorded; slots collapse at 1–3 stores

tickets.title: Accepting an offer produces a validated code and permalink
tickets.objective: Accept endpoint delegates to merchant /codes, returns permalink; records accepted event; handles code-creation failure with re-offer of next slot. Starting-slice mode: simulated/redirect checkout validates the URL against the registered seller domain and emits checkout_redirect + downstream LedgerEvent kinds identical to the Shopify path (C11); Shopify mode delegates to merchant /codes as designed.
acceptance: 1. Accept → code+permalink via stub; ledger events emitted
2. Merchant failure path re-offers deterministically
3. Double-accept on one auction rejected
4. Redirect mode: off-domain checkout_url is refused (release blocker test); emitted event kinds match the Shopify-mode golden sequence

tickets.title: Exchange bandit shifts exposure with outcomes and honors exploration
tickets.objective: Contextual Thompson sampling over cluster×store adjusting exposure/exploration (not formula weights); guaranteed exploration slice for low-data stores from trust snapshot.
acceptance: 1. Seeded sim: positive outcomes for a store raise its exposure in-cluster (S4 pre-check)
2. Exploration slice floor holds for a new store across a window
3. Blacklisted stores draw zero exposure

tickets.title: Loss reports aggregate reasons without leaking amounts
tickets.objective: Windowed job producing LossReport per store: reason categories from the ranking formula's dominant term, unmet criteria for fit losses, delayed release.
acceptance: 1. Golden aggregation from a fixture auction log
2. Output schema contains no prices/amounts/rival ids (property test)
3. Release delay enforced

tickets.title: Tool hooks are the only way facts and discounts enter a bid
tickets.objective: Implement the six hooks per DESIGN §Tool hooks with Provenance on every return; authorize_discount enforces envelope walls; agent-side assembly cannot construct Claims directly (lint + runtime guard).
acceptance: 1. Each hook returns correctly sourced Provenance (unit)
2. authorize_discount denies below-floor/over-cap against approved envelope fixtures
3. Constructing a Claim outside hooks fails lint and runtime guard tests

tickets.title: Advocate runtime bids within walls and defaults deterministically cold
tickets.objective: BidRequest→Bid|decline: cache-layout context assembly, hook-only claim emission, deterministic cold-start bid (list price + standing commitments + intro rule only).
acceptance: 1. Cold agent on fixture store emits the exact deterministic default bid
2. All emitted claims trace to hooks (property test over recorded runs)
3. Decline path produces a valid decline with reason

tickets.title: Store loop learns from its own outcomes only
tickets.objective: Per-store Thompson sampling over discount-depth buckets × commitment sets per cluster; network-prior intake; prior builder consumes pitch/value-prop outcomes only.
acceptance: 1. Seeded outcomes shift the store's own depth distribution toward winners (S4 pre-check)
2. Prior builder rejects/never reads discount fields (schema-level test)
3. Two stores' learned states are independent under identical priors + different outcomes

tickets.title: Shadow mode logs would-be bids and trust events adjust the agent
tickets.objective: Shadow activation gates submission but logs full bids+rationale to sealed store state; TrustEventPayload intake adjusts policy/commitment posture and is visible in rationale.
acceptance: 1. Shadow store: live intents produce logged bids, zero submissions
2. Injected trust event changes subsequent bid rationale deterministically under doubles
3. Activation flip submits without restart

tickets.title: External bids enter signed and route to verification, not rejection
tickets.objective: Signature registration + verification on POST /bid for non-hosted agents; schema validation admits seller_asserted claims and free-text message, marks the bid unverified, and enqueues extraction+verification; hosted path unchanged.
acceptance: 1. Registered-key signed external bid accepted and enqueued for verification; bad signature rejected
2. Hosted bid with non-hook provenance still rejects (regression)
3. Expired/blacklisted external bids reject before enqueue

tickets.title: Three seller personas exercise the external door adversarially
tickets.objective: apps/seller-reference: value / specialist / aggressive personas with identity, catalog scope, tone, and offer policy; free-text pitches with asserted claims via the external /bid path; the aggressive persona emits manifest-scripted false and unsupported claims. Personas may tailor pitches but never redefine catalog facts.
acceptance: 1. Each persona answers a fixture intent concurrently within the deadline (LLM doubles)
2. Aggressive persona's pitches contain exactly the manifest-scripted false/unsupported claims
3. Persona claims arrive as seller_asserted and are marked unverified at intake
non_goals: No verification logic; no hosted-agent code

tickets.title: Installing the app wires pixel and webhooks against the stub
tickets.objective: React Router v7 Shopify app scaffold; install/auth against shopify-stub; webPixelCreate with settings; webhook subscriptions per DESIGN.
acceptance: 1. Install flow completes against stub; offline token stored per shop
2. webPixelCreate called with expected settings payload
3. Webhook subscriptions registered and receivable
tickets.verify: npx vitest run apps/merchant && pytest apps/merchant/svc/tests/test_install.py -q

tickets.title: Pixel reports checkout outcomes the collector can join
tickets.objective: Web pixel extension subscribing standard events; POST via fetch keepalive to collector with clientId, checkout token, order id, discountApplications; collector persists to app schema and forwards LedgerEvents.
acceptance: 1. Stub-emitted checkout_completed lands as checkout_pixel LedgerEvent with join keys
2. Collector tolerates pixel drop-rate mode (no crash, gap visible)
3. No PII fields accepted (schema rejects)
tickets.verify: npx vitest run pixel && pytest apps/merchant/svc/tests/test_collector.py -q

tickets.title: Winning offers become single-use validated codes and permalinks
tickets.objective: /codes: discountCodeBasicCreate usageLimit:1 + expiry, validity + combinesWith pre-check, unique code per accepted offer, permalink construction; duplicate redemption surfaces as offer-integrity event (A5).
acceptance: 1. Code created per offer; permalink applies it in stub redemption
2. Conflicting combinesWith detected pre-redirect (offer re-priced or rejected)
3. Duplicate use emits integrity LedgerEvent, not an exception

tickets.title: A plain-language interview yields an approved, versioned envelope
tickets.objective: Onboarding interview service: LLM interview (double in tests, transcript fixture), envelope draft in plain English, merchant written approval gate, versioned persistence to sealed schema; shadow default.
acceptance: 1. Transcript fixture → exact expected Envelope version (golden)
2. No activation without recorded approval artifact
3. Envelope edits create new versions; old versions immutable

tickets.title: The dashboard shows the walls and the window
tickets.objective: Merchant dashboard: bid log with rationale, loss reports, trust breakdown + event payloads, envelope editor (versioned), kill switch wired to agent mode. Includes verification outcomes per bid (statuses + evidence links).
acceptance: 1. Each pane renders from fixture APIs (component tests)
2. Kill switch flips agent mode via API and is reflected in bid submission tests
3. Loss-report pane displays categories only — render test asserts absence of amount fields

tickets.title: Every event lands once, chained, and replays exactly
tickets.objective: Ledger writer service over T-011 lib: POST /events idempotency, hash chain continuation, replay endpoint proving S3.
acceptance: 1. Duplicate event_id is a no-op
2. Chain verification detects tampering fixture
3. Replay reproduces served snapshot hashes on fixture stream

tickets.title: Webhook truth reconciles lossy pixel signals
tickets.objective: Reconciliation: match checkout_pixel↔order_paid by join keys; emit reconciled events; derive price_honored/discount_honored comparisons from webhook data only.
acceptance: 1. Matched pair → reconciled event with integrity comparisons
2. Webhook-only order (pixel dropped) reconciles cleanly
3. Price/discount mismatch fixture yields integrity deltas sourced from webhook fields

tickets.title: Trust merges verification and outcome observations against the approved manifest
tickets.objective: Merged observation framework: per-dimension Beta with observation-type weights (contradicted 2.0, severe policy 3.0, mismatch returns 1.5; verified claims + fulfilled purchases positive; capped conversion influence), time decay, neutral low-confidence prior ~Beta(2,2), score + confidence + score_version; published threshold; blacklist bound to business identity with review/appeal/expiry states and fail-closed reads.
acceptance: 1. Golden trajectories (verification-only, outcomes-only, mixed) match human-approved fixture manifest expectations
2. Decay + confidence property tests; conversion influence cap holds
3. Blacklist: identity-bound persistence, expiry/appeal states, and fail-closed read behavior (unavailable state blocks checkout) all tested

tickets.title: Trust events reach the store agent and buyers close the loop
tickets.objective: TrustEventPayload push to store-agent intake; feedback flow: routed-buyer-only prompt, buyer-track-record weighting, cross-check against return behavior.
acceptance: 1. Scoring delta pushes payload consumed by T-043 intake (integration)
2. Non-routed buyer feedback rejected
3. 'Great'+returned cross-check downweights feedback (golden)

tickets.title: Exchange consumes one snapshot shape for trust and exploration
tickets.objective: TrustSnapshot API incl. blacklist + low-data flags for the exploration slice; versioned; exchange client.
acceptance: 1. Snapshot schema golden test
2. Blacklisted store flagged; low-data store flagged until manifest N episodes
3. Exchange client caches + refreshes on version bump

tickets.title: A golden pitch yields all four verification statuses with evidence
tickets.objective: packages/verification + trust-service wiring: atomic typed claim extraction with source spans (LLM behind strict schemas, doubles in tests), seller/SKU/variant resolution (ambiguous on failure), unit/type canonicalization, deterministic comparators per DESIGN, statuses verified|contradicted|unsupported|ambiguous with evidence refs + confidence, idempotent per (pitch, verifier version, catalog snapshot), re-verify only on snapshot/verifier change; results persist to ledger tables and emit trust_observations + claim_verified events.
acceptance: 1. Golden pitch fixture (true + false + unsupported + ambiguous claims) returns the four distinct statuses with evidence refs (S8, external ground truth: approved golden set)
2. Idempotency: re-running same (pitch, versions) writes nothing; snapshot bump re-verifies
3. Comparator unit tests: boolean/string normalization, numeric tolerance, price vs offer+catalog, set containment, relationship existence; injection strings in pitch text never execute (C10 test)
non_goals: No trust score math (T-062); no ranking
Does not author the golden set; fixtures/golden/** is T-080's human-approved ground truth, read-only here (closes the SPEC A3 circularity).

tickets.title: Buyers authenticate lightly and stores never see who they are
tickets.objective: Chat shell, magic-link auth, vault mapping email↔pseudonym history, per-session pseudonym rotation; only vault role reads mappings.
acceptance: 1. Login issues session + fresh pseudonym; prior pseudonyms never reissued
2. Grant test: non-vault roles cannot read vault.*
3. Profile objects contain no identity fields (schema property test)
tickets.verify: npx vitest run apps/buyer && pytest apps/buyer/svc/tests/test_auth_vault.py -q

tickets.title: Three questions or fewer produce a confirmed structured intent
tickets.objective: Buyer agent: clarification loop capped at 3, Intent construction + buyer confirmation UI, profile bucket builder with k-floor config.
acceptance: 1. Scripted dialogues (fixtures) yield expected Intents within ≤3 questions
2. Confirmation required before auction creation
3. Bucket builder outputs only DESIGN profile fields; k-floor honored at configured value
tickets.verify: pytest apps/buyer/svc/tests/test_intent.py -q && npx vitest run apps/buyer/app/intent

tickets.title: Shortlists render with provenance and accept hands off cleanly
tickets.objective: Shortlist UI: slots, trust indicator, provenance labels ('store-confirmed' vs 'from their website'); accept → exchange accept → redirect to permalink.
acceptance: 1. Component tests for slot rendering incl. collapsed-slot cases
2. Provenance labels map from Provenance.source correctly (golden)
3. Accept path e2e-to-stub returns and follows permalink
tickets.verify: npx vitest run apps/buyer/app/shortlist && pytest apps/buyer/svc/tests/test_accept_flow.py -q

tickets.title: Routed buyers can answer one structured feedback prompt
tickets.objective: Post-purchase feedback UI + intake wiring to trust feedback API; one prompt, structured options, no free text.
acceptance: 1. Prompt shown only for routed orders (fixture)
2. Submission lands as feedback LedgerEvent
3. No free-text field exists (render test)
tickets.verify: npx vitest run apps/buyer/app/feedback && pytest apps/buyer/svc/tests/test_feedback.py -q

tickets.title: The approved manifest and seed generator define ground truth
tickets.objective: Fixture manifest: dishonest-store behaviors, new-store prior N, seeds, expected trust trajectories — submitted for human approval (approval artifact committed). Parameterized SEED_CATEGORY catalog generator + `make demo-seed` provisioning stub or live stores. Manifest also defines the golden intent/pitch set (incl. persona scripts, contradiction/stale/variant/unit/injection/claim-splitting cases) used by verification and eval gates.
acceptance: 1. Manifest + golden set committed with recorded human approval artifact
2. Generator seeds N stores incl. the dishonest one into shopify-stub from SEED_CATEGORY config
3. `make demo-seed` idempotent against stub

tickets.title: Simulated buyers exercise the whole network from one seed
tickets.objective: services/sim: seeded traffic generator driving intents→auctions→acceptances→stub purchases/returns; dishonest-store script executes manifest behaviors.
acceptance: 1. Fixed seed reproduces identical event streams twice
2. Dishonest script emits exactly the manifest behaviors
3. Sim runs headless against compose in bounded steps

tickets.title: One scripted run proves the full S1 flow
tickets.objective: E2E test: intent→clarify→bids→shortlist→accept→code→stub checkout→pixel+webhook→reconcile→ledger→trust update, all against compose.
acceptance: 1. The full chain asserts an EXACT per-kind multiset over the complete LedgerEvent enum (D34), not "exactly once": bid_placed == n_stores_solicited (read from the run fixture); shown == len(shortlist.slots); auction_opened == auction_closed == accepted == code_created == checkout_redirect == checkout_pixel == order_paid == reconciled == 1; refund == order_fulfilled == feedback == offer_integrity == blacklisted == blacklist_expired == 0; claim_verified == the run's asserted-claim count. A subset or >=1 assertion does not satisfy this criterion.
2. Shortlist contained fallback + hosted bids
3. Run completes offline
4. Release-blocker assertions: no blacklisted seller eligible anywhere in the run; no off-domain checkout URL returned

tickets.title: Both learning loops demonstrably move under seeded outcomes
tickets.objective: Simulation assertions for S4: outcome shifts reorder shortlists in-cluster (exchange loop); a store's discount-depth distribution tracks its own record (store loop).
acceptance: 1. Seeded run A vs B (outcome flip) produces the expected ranking reorder (golden)
2. Store depth distribution shifts direction matches record (statistical test, fixed seed)
3. Control store unaffected

tickets.title: The dishonest store ends below threshold and off the shortlist
tickets.objective: Episode test for S2: run manifest budget of simulated episodes; assert trust trajectory matches approved manifest expectations, ends blacklisted, and store disappears from subsequent shortlists.
acceptance: 1. Trajectory within manifest tolerance bands
2. Blacklist event emitted at expected episode ±band
3. Post-blacklist auctions contain zero exposure for the store
non_goals: No manifest edits (would invalidate ground truth)

tickets.title: The demo is a runbook anyone on the team can execute
tickets.objective: Demo procedure doc: dev-store provisioning (app install, password config, Bogus Gateway), `make e2e-live` runbook, and the two demo beats (live auction; interview→bidding onboarding). Lint-checked structure with required sections and command presence.
acceptance: 1. Runbook lints: required sections + referenced make targets exist
2. Interview beat references T-053 transcript flow with a live-LLM variant flagged
